title: HSS Observation
description: Machine-readable schema for an HSS observation unit. This schema is for structured observation, not for truth claims or diagnostic scoring.

observation_mode.description: Type of HSS observation target. Use design_proposal or hypothetical_case when the target has a decomposable design structure but lacks actual traces.

excluded_scope.description: Scope explicitly excluded from the observation.

non_claims.description: Claims the observation does not make.

claimed_connection.description: The connection that is said or assumed to exist in the target.

mediating_symbol.description: Symbols mediating the connection. Symbols are treated as entry points for connection or processing forms, not as meaning itself.

processing_form.description: Forms into which the target is converted, such as KPI, ranking, approval, price, API call, feed slot, or template.

trace.description: Observable traces such as saves, quotes, logs, conversations, revisits, discomfort, repeated use, or residual memory. For design_proposal and hypothetical_case, mark unobserved traces with actual_trace_unconfirmed in connection_status.

routing.description: Observed or suspected routes through which the connection or trace flows. For design proposals, separate intended routing from actually observed routing.

reconnectable_path.description: Paths through which the target can return to its original or alternative contexts.

design_structure.description: For design_proposal or hypothetical_case: decomposed intended structure, separated from actual traces.

layer_mapping.description: Provisional mapping of observations to HSS layers.

fixation.description: Observed fixation of symbols, interpretations, routes, or roles.

blue_residuals.description: Unabsorbed interpretation room, discomfort, traces, or reconnectability left after processing.

shiwa.description: Lived creases / frictional traces from layered experience, memory, failure, discomfort, or continued connection.

reconnectable_difference.description: Differences that preserve reconnectability while opening new connections or interpretations.

feedback_deficit.description: Places where negative feedback, discomfort, re-evaluation, or corrective return appears weakened or delayed.

objective_function_capture.description: Places where an external objective function appears to capture routing, evaluation, or purpose.

reserved_layer_notes.description: Notes for possible L7-L8 influences. These must not be directly modeled unless visible as L1-L6 traces.

connection_status.description: Connection confirmation statuses. For design_proposal, use design_structure_decomposed for the design and actual_connection_unconfirmed / actual_trace_unconfirmed for missing real-world confirmation.

evidence.description: Evidence snippets, links, observations, or notes that support the connection decomposition.

uncertainty.description: Weak points, unobserved traces, missing routing, or over-interpretation risks.
